← Vibe One & Vibe Law

Your local build companion.

The website connects to the Vibe platform running on your computer. The companion includes the Workbench, Practice editor, original Studio and both offering interfaces.

Download source ZIPView the repository ↗The repository is private. Sign in to GitHub with an account that has access.
  1. Install Node.js 22 or newer and Git. Install the official Codex desktop app or CLI and sign in with codex login.
  2. Download and extract the ZIP, or clone the repository:
    git clone https://github.com/gendaiski/Vibe-One.git
  3. Open the project folder and run Start-Platform.ps1. Open the local frontend and create your local account.

Use the installed desktop-bundled Codex where available. The compiled editor is included; no website build step is needed to start the companion.

Account data, uploads and generated user projects are local and excluded from the repository. Offering access is a free local trial. No payment is collected.
